chosen.title: How To T-Bar Row The Right Way! (BACK BUILDER!)
chosen.description:
The T-Bar row is one of our favorite exercises to activate your lats and the rest of your back muscles to build a wide, aesthetic back. People often don't get it right or don't include the exercise. Watch this video to learn more about just what makes the T-Bar row so effective.


Set Up
- We like to use a little bit of a closer grip attachment when we are doing the T-Bar Row
    - Make sure to get the grip under the bar
        - Deadlift it up
            - Hips back and torso tall
    - Pulling inward by retracting the scapula completely
        - Think that you are bringing your shoulders down and back
What do people do wrong?
- A lot of people round and go forward with the bar, which hurts the extended position that the T-Bar row gets so much benefit from
    - Make sure to maintain upright position
Secret Tip:
- Use smaller plates!
    - Smaller circumference allows way more range of motion
        - Helps more muscle fibers to fire!
